More about me

How I work

A short, plain process, so you always know what happens next.

1. Map how it runs today

We walk through how enquiries, bookings and follow-ups really move, and where they get stuck.

2. Build the fix

I build the system that removes the constraint, using the tools your business already runs on where possible.

3. Check it and tune it

We test it on real activity, watch whether it moved, and adjust until you trust it.

What I fix

Every build starts with one of three goals. The tools come second.

Get more customers

Lead qualification, Instant follow-up, Booking automation.

Make each customer worth more

CRM automation, Onboarding flows, Review and referral systems.

Cut costs

Internal knowledge assistants, Reporting dashboards, Ticket sorting.

The short story

I help business owners get real value from AI without hiring a technical team. I map how the business actually runs, find the constraint that costs the most time or money, and build the system that fixes it with tools like Claude, Claude Code, n8n, Zapier, Make.com, HubSpot and GoHighLevel.

My background is in engineering (Federal University of Technology, Akure). Lab and field work trained me to observe systems closely, run controlled experiments and measure results. I apply the same discipline to business workflows: define the KPI, record the baseline, ship one thing, and track whether it moved.

I’m honest about what AI can and can’t do. Sometimes the right fix is a plain workflow, and I’ll say so. The goal is a system you trust and use every day.

How I think about the work

Find the constraint, not just the annoyance.
